Name: SkipHour
Author: atudota
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#999999]Description[/color][/b][/size]
Aren't you tired of waiting for the store or forge to open? I am too, so I made a mod that will save you from waiting. And if you don't like the picture, you can change it.

[color=#999999][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Place the mod in the mods folder.[/b] [/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]

Manifest.Description: Adds a HUD button to advance in-game time by one hour.
